slides.title: Your ventures produce more data than anyone can process.
slides.body: Customer calls, internal meetings, Slack threads, documents, pipeline numbers. Decisions wait for someone to piece the picture together, and momentum dies in the gap.

slides.title: Krans models each venture, and every signal moves it.
slides.body: A pricing objection, a churn number, a decision half-made in a Monday meeting: each one lands against the part of the model it touches.

slides.title: Every claim has to earn its place on the model.

points.title: Cited
points.body: Each input becomes a passage in someone’s own words, pinned to who said it and when.

points.title: Graded
points.body: Every learning sits on an evidence scale, from E0, vague, to E5, they put something at stake.

points.title: Ageing
points.body: A claim nobody has repeated for sixty days loses weight, along with the positions built on it.

slides.title: Structure that meeting recorders, CRMs and chat products do not have.

points.title: Threads
points.body: Nothing a buyer said gets lost, even months later.

points.title: Signals
points.body: One buyer saying it is noise. Five buyers saying it is a signal.

points.title: Positions
points.body: You see which of your bets are backed, and which are guesses.

slides.title: Where each venture stands, and what it needs next.
slides.body: Every morning, each venture gets a clear read, each relationship gets its next move, and every call gets an honest review.

points.title: Ventures
points.body: Monday morning, you know which venture needs you, and why.

points.title: Deals
points.body: Next steps written before you have found your notes.

points.title: Calls
points.body: You walk into the call knowing what killed the last three.

slides.title: For portfolios that run more ventures than anyone can sit in calls for.
